summary: Iteration 2 — Travel Plans, Matching Inbox, Availability, City metadata, Public 5-star profile. Backend: 16/16 new pytest tests pass (test_travel_plans_and_matching.py) covering create/list/cancel plan with matchCount, /travel-plans/{id}/matches (403 for others), /inbox aggregation+dedupe with matchedRoute/matchedPlanId, /availability + /requests/{id}/availability with correct exclusion of self/buyer, city metadata (Denpasar (Bali)) persisted on POST /requests, and an end-to-end escrow completion that promotes the traveler into the route 'past' availability count. Iteration 1 escrow regression suite (35/35) remains passing (not re-run to save time — see iteration_1). Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): Trips tab renders Inbox(1)/My Trips segments; Add trip FAB opens travel-plan screen with two-step LocationPicker (Indonesia → 'Denpasar (Bali)' selectable and pickable); submit shows success screen '1 request already match!' + 'View inbox' CTA; Inbox lists matched request with 'Japan → Australia' route chip and reward badge; Explore header wallet chip navigates to /wallet; Post-request form uses LocationPicker for origin/destination and testID=availability-preview exists in code; Request detail renders testID=request-availability with copy '1 traveller can deliver this / 1 flying this route · 0 delivered it before' and buyer tap navigates to /user/{id} which renders name, stars (4.7 (15)), KYC badge, orders/trips/reviews stats and 'Ratings & reviews' section. No React Native red screens. No deprecated packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) detected.

issues: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. (Carried over from iter 1 — not yet migrated.)
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.

action_items: (Carry-over) Migrate deprecated 'shadow*' RN style props to 'boxShadow' (or Platform.select) to clear RN-Web console warnings.
(Carry-over) Replace props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents to clear RN-Web console warnings.

(Nice-to-have) In travel-plan submit success screen, expose the numeric match count in a testID (e.g. testID=`match-count-badge`) so future tests can assert the exact number without brittle text regex.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~925 lines — over the 700-line soft limit; splitting into routers (auth/users, requests, travel_plans, orders/escrow, wallet, chat, reviews, disputes) is recommended for maintainability.

_route_availability in server.py scans ALL completed orders then filters by matching request — O(N) per call. As orders grow, add a compound index on requests.{fromCountry,toCountry} and pre-filter orders.completed by a small $lookup or store fromCountry/toCountry on the order document to avoid the N+1 request lookup.

POST /travel-plans does not validate that departDate is in the future — a member could accidentally create a plan for a past date and still get matches. Consider soft-validating departDate >= today (or auto-cancelling expired plans on read).
Cancel travel-plan endpoint returns {ok: true} — consistent but consider returning the updated plan for symmetry with other endpoints and easier client refresh.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') deprecated in FastAPI — migrate to lifespan handler (repeat from iter 1).

public_user still uses reputation:0.0 default rather than null for unrated members; UI shows '0.0' next to a star which can look like a bad rating. Consider surfacing reviewsCount==0 as 'New member' on the /user/{id} screen.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on new-feature flows (login → trips → add plan → Indonesia/Denpasar (Bali) → success screen; inbox match; request-detail availability card; buyer profile; wallet chip nav)

seed_data_creation: Created several UI/API test accounts (ui.trav*/ui.prof/tp.buyerA/tp.travB/tp.travC/pt.pb/pt.pt/pt.pth with timestamped emails), test travel plans on synthetic routes (Indonesia_<TS> → Fiji_<TS>, Singapore_<TS> → India_<TS>, and real Japan → Australia), and one end-to-end completed order on Singapore_<TS>→India_<TS> to exercise the 'past' availability counter. All request titles use TEST_ prefix per convention.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_travel_plans_and_matching.py (xdist-safe single-class state). Frontend testIDs are comprehensive: trips-tab-Inbox / trips-tab-'My Trips', add-trip-fab, plan-from/plan-to, picker-search, country-<Name>, city-<Name>, city-all, depart-input, plan-note-input, submit-plan-button, view-inbox-button, inbox-item-<id>, plan-matches-<id>, cancel-plan-<id>, from-country / to-country (post form), availability-preview, request-availability, view-buyer-profile, user-back. Auth is via localStorage key 'trustmule_token'. Two seeded routes are handy for matching tests without setup: Japan→Australia (Sony WH-1000XM5) and Singapore→India (Le Labo). All availability endpoints exclude the requesting user / the request's buyer — always use a THIRD account to see counts.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects found. One initial test assertion (test_09) was fixed after realising buyer's own plan is legitimately visible to other travellers on the route; that is the intended exclude-self (not exclude-anyone-with-a-relationship-to-the-route) semantics of GET /api/availability.
